thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH — Reserved pool latency spike for tenant 'sparrow-prod' (Sparrow Health). AlertID RED-89012. p95/p99 > 1.5s for 3m. auto-escalate thresholds hit.

maria chen: acked. I'm on it, pulling metrics now. link: https://grafana.company/sparrow-prod/reserved-pool

aj patel: oncall here, also seeing queue depth jump on sparrow-prod-01. KV cache evictions spiking. likely burst from nightly batch job?

chris wong: opened runbook: reserved-capacity-throttle. initial mitigation: try temporary reserved increase or enable shared-burst. which do we prefer for latency recovery?

maria chen: we should increase reserved first to avoid noisy neighbor on shared. If it doesn't drop in 5m, enable shared burst.

aj patel: copying logs: ```ERROR serve: request_timeout tenant=sparrow id=6f2a... status=503 latency=1823ms``` also seeing ``kv_evictions=124`` in the last minute.

chris wong: running increase command now (runbook step 3). ```rwctl reserved increase --tenant=sparrow --units=2 --reason="auto-pager - spike"```

devops-bot: Command received: rwctl reserved increase --tenant=sparrow --units=2. Progress: queued -> applied (ETA ~40s). audit_id: AID-59123

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page escalated to level 2 — team lead notified (escalation window reached).

maria chen: seeing cluster target scale up, instances coming up on sparrow-prod-02/03. p95 dropping to ~680ms after node join.

aj patel: good improvement but long-tail still at p99 ~1.2s for some model shards. I suspect KV cache warm-up. recommending enabling fallback routing to compatible model-variant-lite for tail requests.

chris wong: to enable fallback: ```routerctl set-fallback --tenant=sparrow --fallback=variant-lite --duration=10m``` should reduce tail latency quickly.

maria chen: applied fallback routing. monitoring. p99 now ~720ms, 503 rate down to near 0.

aj patel: still seeing a handful of requests time out from a specific AZ (us-east-2). network spike? @infra-sre to confirm.

maria chen: good catch. I've rebalanced some routing away from us-east-2 nodes for Sparrow.

chris wong: small config tweak to reduce batch sizes (trade throughput for tail latency): ```deploycfg set --tenant=sparrow --batch_max_tokens=128```. Would prefer this temporarily while cache warms.

maria chen: applied batch_max_tokens=128. tail improved.

maria chen: next steps: open post-incident ticket, notify Sparrow CS and engineering, schedule follow-up to adjust autoscale thresholds and investigate nightly job pattern. tagging runbook items completed: reserved-increase, fallback-routing, batch-tune.

maria chen: FYI pinging @pagerduty: acknowledged, handoff if degraded > 15m escalate to oncall lead.

pagerduty: Acknowledged by maria chen. No further automatic escalations for now.

incident-bot: Alert RESOLVED — RED-89012: Reserved pool latency for tenant 'sparrow-prod' returned to normal for 10m. Close reason: reserved capacity scaled + fallback + batch tuning.

maria chen: closing thread, will create infra ticket with timeline and remediation items. thanks all. :thumbsup:
